purpose: Clinical research to improve prevention and health service planning.
question: Could you give us a single headcount of adults living with Bluthochdruck? We mean a recorded hypertension diagnosis, not just one high reading, and do not need a regional breakdown.
definitions: Exclude patients who opted out of reuse.
Use 31 December 2025 as the reference date; age is 2025 minus birth year.
Hypertension means a conditions.icd10 code beginning I10.
Count each adult (18 years or older) once; metric: hypertension_adults.
